standard_prerequisites.name: Roelcke colorings at a point of the Roelcke compactification
standard_prerequisites.statement: For a Fraisse structure with Roelcke precompact automorphism group the article attaches to each point x of the Roelcke compactification the class of colorings that are Roelcke at x, that is, the finite colorings of the copies of a finite substructure that are uniformly continuous at that point of the compactification; this is the class whose Ramsey property the article studies. The author's own definitions are the ones used by the counted statement and proof.
standard_prerequisites.use: The counted proposition is the criterion that recognises membership in this class combinatorially, by producing a single joint embedding whose pattern determines all the values of the coloring.

standard_prerequisites.name: Joint embeddings and their patterns
standard_prerequisites.statement: For a point x represented by two maps the article considers joint embeddings of the form given by the first map and the second composed with an embedding of a finite structure, and the pattern of such a joint embedding is the function that assigns to every copy the corresponding pair of maps; finite colorings of the copies that only depend on that pattern are exactly the ones the article calls determined by the joint embedding. The author's own definitions are the ones used by the counted statement and proof.
standard_prerequisites.use: The statement of the counted proposition is phrased with these objects: the coloring belongs to the class at x if and only if some joint embedding of that form determines it.

core_obligations: Forward direction: assume the structure has the Ramsey property for the colorings of the class at x, fix finite substructures and a joint embedding of the stated form, and consider the coloring that assigns to each copy the pattern of the joint embedding (source line 576).
Show that this coloring is finite, appealing to the article's proposition characterising Roelcke precompactness (source line 576).
Show that this coloring lies in the class at x, appealing to the extension criterion for Roelcke colorings at a point, which is the article's earlier proposition of that name (source line 576).

Conclude the forward direction: the Ramsey property applied to that one coloring produces the copy on which the coloring is constant, that is, the copy on which the pattern readings agree (source line 576).

Converse direction: the earlier extension criterion gives the membership in the class, and a finite set of colorings of the class can be captured by one single such coloring, the argument being the one given in the proof of the article's earlier proposition on the class (source line 576).

proof_roadmap.step: Assume the Ramsey property for the colorings of the class at x, and read off the coloring determined by a fixed joint embedding of the stated form.

Establish the two properties of that coloring needed to apply the hypothesis: it is finite, by the characterisation of Roelcke precompactness, and it belongs to the class at x, by the extension criterion.

Apply the Ramsey property to the coloring to obtain the required copy, which proves the forward implication; the converse follows from the extension criterion together with the capture of a finite set of colorings by a single one.

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 doi:10.5802/ahl.16 的 Proposition prop:Roelcke ext coloring（源 567-569 行，证明与 prop:RPExtRoelcke 共用 575-577 行）：设 F 是 Roelcke 预紧自同构群的 Fraïssé 结构、x=[φ1,φ2] 是 Roelcke 紧化的点、χ 是有限着色，则 χ 属于该类当且仅当存在 Z 与形如 ⟨φ1, φ2∘z⟩ 的联合嵌入使 χ(a) 只依赖模式 [φ1∘a, φ2∘z]。关键操作不是例行核验：正方向要把「由联合嵌入读出的着色」识别为**既有限又属于类**（前者用 Roelcke 预紧的刻画命题，后者正是同章的扩张判据），再把 Ramsey 性质作用在这**单个**着色上取出所需的拷贝；反方向则要靠**有限多个这类着色可被一个着色同时捕获**（论证在 prop:RoelckeRP 的证明里）才能把单项的 Ramsey 性质抬到有限族。难点在于把「成员资格」翻译成「一个联合嵌入决定全部取值」，以及把 Ramsey 性质从单项着色抬到有限族。原文位置在证明的 576 行（三条承重句：定义染色、两项性质、结论与反向）。

editorial_notes: The counted unit is the article's own Proposition prop:Roelcke ext coloring at source lines 567-569 together with its proof at source lines 575-577. The proof block is shared: the next statement, prop:RPExtRoelcke at lines 571-573, is proved by the same block, and both pointers in the proof refer to it. The source is the publisher version of the article in Annales Henri Lebesgue 2 (2019), pages 149-185, DOI 10.5802/ahl.16, released under CC BY 4.0.

The competing candidate of the same block, prop:RPExtRoelcke, is not counted: the article needs both statements on their own, and the counted one is the membership criterion that the proof reads off first, while the adjacent one is the transfer condition quantified over all finite substructures and all joint embeddings. Recording the shared block here keeps the pairing honest, and the adjacent statement is declared as a navigation pointer.

The licence evidence used here is the observation file kept with the source, license-observation.json, which records the licence as CC BY 4.0, points at the inherited publisher-version evidence and states that the landing page displays no licence line; the underlying evidence files are the same ones the earlier cards of this source rely on. No acceptance record is written anywhere.

All three pointers of this card belong to the same chapter of the article and were numbered the way the article itself numbers its statements: the theorem-like environments share one counter attached to the section, so the printed number of each is the section and its place inside that section. The count was made by enumerating every numbered theorem-like environment of the source in order and reading each index off that enumeration: 4.2 for the characterisation of Roelcke precompactness, 4.9 for the extension criterion and 4.5 for the proposition on the Ramsey property of the class. An earlier attempt of this lane used the place in the whole article instead, which is not the printed number, and the cards of this source were all audited against the section-scoped enumeration. The anchors recorded point at each statement's own lines.

The retained preamble is the source's editorial preamble with three omissions only: the class line, which the assembler supplies; the page geometry; and the fontspec block with its explicit font files, which would fight the forced xelatex engine. Everything else, including the theorem declarations under the shared counter and the whole macro block, is retained verbatim.
Neither the retained statement nor the retained proof contains a citation, so this card needs no bibliography entry.

The census package marked this candidate free of missing citation keys and listed the statement span as 567-569 and the proof span as 575-577; both were re-read from the source before the card was written. The proof is dense in the source, three sentences spread over two long lines, and every mathematical move it names is a pointer to another statement of the article, all three of which are declared. Revision r002 of this card replaces the place-in-the-article numbering of the three pointers with the section-scoped printed numbers.
